title: Adaptive decision-making for stochastic service network design
summary: This paper addresses the Service Network Design (SND) problem for a logistics service provider (LSP) operating in a multimodal freight transport network, considering uncertain travel times and limited truck fleet availability. A two-stage optimization approach is proposed, which combines metaheuristics, simulation and machine learning components.
